notes: Clean, fair puzzle. Each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and every constraint is checkable from card plus reviews.
Fairly obvious: Cyrus's bullet-point summary restates all four constraints, so the chat does the work for the player. Fine for an early level, but it leaves little to discover.
Liam says 'crunchy ones'. No review mentions crunchy or hard-shell tacos, so I treated it as flavour rather than a separate preference. If it was meant to be scored, no venue gives evidence for it.
Mole Cantina's peanut evidence is explicit ('made with ground peanuts'), so the allergy trap is easy to spot once you read the reviews.
